# Democratic Republic of the Congo

> [!summary] Data available
> Almost all food data comes from [[World Wide Dishes]]: 21 dishes (15 DRC-only), in Lingala, from Kinshasa and Katanga; [[WorldCuisines]] adds 2. No recipes with amounts and no FCT in the vault; plants via [[CMAUP]] (92) and [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] (53 records).

## Foods & dishes
- [[World Wide Dishes]]: **21 dishes (15 DRC-only)**; free-text ingredients, no amounts or method, plus eating context (time of day, occasion, utensils, local-language name). Lingala 19 dishes; Kinshasa, Katanga, Goma, Lomami. Examples: cassava-leaf stew with beans, trois pièces, spinach with smoked fish, amaranth, beef-offal broth.
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 2 dishes (shared). [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions|Food.com]] has a `congolese` tag (11) that does not say which Congo.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national FCT is in the vault or `Backlog/`. The [[FAO INFOODS global databases]] candidate (priority 2, directory of 308 tables) is where a national or regional table would be found. Fallback: [[USDA FoodData Central]] by name matching.
- Plant occurrence: [[CMAUP]] 92 plants.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 53 ethnobotany records (28 taxa, listed as Zaire). [[KNApSAcK Family]] lists the DRC on its World map, but African flag pages were not scraped (counts unknown).
- Compound → effect chains come from the global backbone via [[Global]] ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions).

## Gaps
- No FCT, no recipes, no knowledge QA for a country of over 100 million people; eastern and Kasai cuisines barely appear.
